name: Hokuto Driving School
description: A calm, photograph-led theme for a family driving school: pale concrete, kerb stone and asphalt ink with one deep slate-green band and a faded road-sign sage, Newsreader over Instrument Sans. The home page opens on a full-bleed photograph of an empty early-morning road under a transparent top header, with a quiet facts bar along its foot; then a letter from the owner beside the practice yard, the route from the yard to test day as six photographed stages, plain prices beside a lesson photograph, the four instructors, a dark band for nervous drivers with a learner's words, the journal and a booking call. With Courses & fees, The Route (six stages in detail), Instructors, Nervous drivers, Test day, About (the school year by year and a day at the depot), Contact, Newsletter and Journal. The school details and booking-desk hours are one synced pattern, edited once.
